description: Defaults keep an empty list's element type, so a wrong element type is still an error
notes: Not disputed like native/functions/function-error-is-eval-error: the README defines convert's result as the conversion, and the spec decides conversions between collection types by their element types (spec.md#collection-and-structural-type-conversions), so a string element type can't become an object type even with no elements; applying defaults keeps the empty list's element type (Defaults.Apply in ext/typeexpr/defaults.go).
